newsitem.title: INDIA: Shares in India Bata up on 6-mth results.
newsitem.headline: Shares in India Bata up on 6-mth results.

text.p: Shares of India's leading shoe-maker Bata India rose 4.0 rupees, or nearly three percent, to 148.0 at the Bombay exchange on Thursday after the firm announced a sharp rise in its six-month profits, traders said.
Bata said its net profit in the six months ending June 30, 1997 surged to 83.5 million rupees from 1.5 million rupees in the corresponding period a year ago.
The company's shares briefly hit a record high of 153.25 rupees in afternoon trade but heavy selling forced the stock to settle lower, dealers said.

"The turnaround in performance is attributed to the current marketing strategy, which emphasises the introduction of low- to medium-price footwear at popular prices, together with restructuring measures and cost reduction."
Bata shares traded 1.05 rupees higher at 147.05 on the National Stock Exchange.
